purpose: What has and has not been checked for each model used on a Patient Lab result page, in the four validation layers of docs/PATIENT_LAB_2_0.md. Shown in every run record so a result is read together with the evidence behind its model.

layers.software_verification: The code computes the intended equations.
layers.transcription_verification: The parameters and equations match the source.
layers.reproduction: The model reproduces results from the data it was fitted to.
layers.external_consistency: Agreement with data not used to fit the model.

never_established: Clinical prediction validity. Passing every layer supports research use only; clinical_prediction_validated stays false.

lenalidomide_hughes_2019.name: Lenalidomide population PK (Hughes et al. 2019)
lenalidomide_hughes_2019.citation: Hughes et al. Br J Clin Pharmacol. 2019;85:924-934

software_verification.summary: Solver checked against an independent analytic reference on synthetic cases.

transcription_verification.summary: Main-text parameter table reviewed. The supplementary control stream (Supplementary Material 2) was reviewed for the random-effect and residual-error blocks (hughes_variability_extract_v1.json, 13 October 2026); the structural parameters have not been cross-checked against it.

reproduction.summary: No reproduction of the source's own published results has been run on this platform.

external_consistency.summary: Aggregate check of group-mean exposure relative to normal renal function, study CC-5013-PK-001 (EMA assessment): mild consistent; moderate and severe under-predicted. Correction recorded 31 October 2026: the study groups were defined by measured creatinine clearance (EMA table), not by the Cockcroft-Gault value the model uses, which the plan said was not stated. Post hoc, a lower Cockcroft-Gault value changes this model's exposure by about 10% at most over the moderate range, so it does not explain the 2-fold result (lenalidomide_renal_source_reconciliation_v1.json).

lenalidomide_kim_2026.name: Lenalidomide population PK in renal impairment (Kim et al. 2026)
lenalidomide_kim_2026.citation: Kim H, Park SS, Choi S, et al. Drug Des Devel Ther. 2026;20:605741

software_verification.summary: Exact two-compartment solution checked against numerical integration in the test suite.

transcription_verification.summary: Tables and printed equations transcribed; the printed CL/F equation form conflicts with the paper's own results, and a multiplicative reading is used until the authors confirm.

reproduction.summary: Typical total CL/F at each group's median covariates lies within one SD of the authors' Table 2 group means. Same patients as the fit, so this confirms transcription, not predictive performance.

external_consistency.summary: Aggregate check of group-mean exposure relative to normal renal function, study CC-5013-PK-001 (EMA assessment): mild and moderate consistent; severe under-predicted in the primary scenario (consistent in some alternative scenarios). Correction recorded 31 October 2026: the study groups were defined by measured creatinine clearance (EMA table), not by the Cockcroft-Gault value the model uses, which the plan said was not stated. Post hoc, eGFR 5-15 mL/min lower would raise this model's exposure about 1.07- to 1.22-fold, comparable to the severe-group under-prediction, so the severe and moderate results may be sensitive to this (lenalidomide_renal_source_reconciliation_v1.json).

bortezomib_platelets_lignet_2022.name: Bortezomib thrombocytopenia model (Lignet et al. 2022)
bortezomib_platelets_lignet_2022.citation: Lignet F, et al. CPT Pharmacometrics Syst Pharmacol. 2022;11(5):594-603

software_verification.summary: Exact three-compartment PK solution checked against numerical integration; platelet integration repeated at half step size.

transcription_verification.summary: AI-assisted transcription from the article and supplement; independent review pending. Units of the drug-effect term and its bound were not stated and were settled by the reproduction check.

reproduction.summary: Locked check against the fitting data (Lonial 2005): both variants consistent with the observed cycle 1 day 11 fall only with concentrations in ng/mL and the effect term as printed.

external_consistency.summary: No usable outside data. The Japanese phase I/II study (NCT00752518; Ogawa et al. 2008; sponsor report CR009058; 0.7, 1.0 and 1.3 mg/m2, same schedule) is the only candidate found. Neither the paper nor the public synopsis gives platelet counts over time; the full report, which tabulated hematology values by testing time, is not public.

candidates.result: No results posted (hasResults false); links the sponsor synopsis.

candidates.source: Janssen clinical study report synopsis CR009058 (11 pages, dated 19 December 2006)
candidates.storage: Kept on the platform owner's computer only; not committed.
candidates.result: No platelet values over time. Page 7 states descriptive statistics of hematology values by testing time and time to nadir and recovery were calculated in the full report. Grade 3 or higher platelet decrease is not among the grade 3 or higher events listed (lowest listed 23.5%); thrombocytopenia is reported once as a serious event (1/34).

candidates.source: Ogawa Y, Tobinai K, Ogura M, et al. Cancer Sci. 2008;99(1):140-144. doi:10.1111/j.1349-7006.2007.00638.x
candidates.storage: Kept on the platform owner's computer only; not committed.
candidates.result: No platelet values over time; Figure 1 shows only plasma concentrations and 20S proteasome inhibition. Table 2 gives thrombocytopenia by NCI-CTC grade: at 1.3 mg/m2 (n = 25), grade 1/2 in 12 and grade 3/4 in 11 patients; 28 of 34 (82%) overall. Entry required platelets of at least 75 x10^9/L.

candidates.source: Shi DS, et al. J Clin Invest. 2014;124(9):3757-3766
candidates.result: Mouse data only; supports the platelet-production mechanism, cannot test patient counts.

search.why_incidence_alone_is_not_used: The model gives one typical curve with no between-patient spread, so it cannot predict the share of patients below a grade threshold; comparing it with incidences would not test it.
search.possible_route: Request the patient-level or full-report hematology data through the sponsor's data-sharing route (Janssen trials are shared through the YODA Project).

bortezomib_pk_lignet_2022.name: Bortezomib three-compartment PK (Lignet 2022, from Hanley 2017)
bortezomib_pk_lignet_2022.citation: Lignet F, et al. CPT Pharmacometrics Syst Pharmacol. 2022;11(5):594-603
bortezomib_pk_lignet_2022.role: Drives the platelet model; not offered as patient PK.

software_verification.summary: Exact three-exponential solution checked against independent numerical integration across doses.

transcription_verification.summary: Table 1 per-m2 parameters checked against the pediatric source values and the stated scaling; independent review pending.

reproduction.summary: The source shows PK only graphically against Reece 2011; no reproduction run here.

external_consistency.summary: Ogawa 2008 (Japanese patients), with the model sampled at the study times and analysed the same way. At 1.3 mg/m2: day 11 exposure consistent, near the upper limit (model 248 vs observed mean 187 ng.h/mL, 95% CI to 248); day 1 exposure 2.9-fold too high; the day 1 to day 11 rise 1.9-fold against 5.1-fold observed. Day 1 is over-predicted at all three doses (5.1-fold at 0.7, 3.6-fold at 1.0) and the model's rise is below the observed mean at all three. The single clearance matches repeat-dose, not first-dose, exposure.

further_reports.summary: CAN-1004 (FDA review of NDA 021602 S-027; IV, 1.3 mg/m2, n = 10, sampling to 72 h), with the model sampled at the study times and analysed the same way (plan locked before computation): day 1 exposure consistent (AUC to 72 h 81 vs observed 104 ng.h/mL, 95% CI 33-175); day 11 under-predicted (127 vs 241, 95% CI 182-300); rise from day 1 to day 11 1.6-fold against 2.3-fold (ratio of means). The day 1 over-prediction seen with Ogawa 2008 is not reproduced; the too-small rise is seen in both studies. All classifications hold under four NCA readings.

lenalidomide_renal_pathways_2026.name: Lenalidomide elimination pathways (filtration, secretion, non-renal; Simulation 2.0a)
lenalidomide_renal_pathways_2026.citation: Platform model built from EMA assessment report EMEA/CHMP/249329/2008, study CC-5013-PK-001

software_verification.summary: Calibration arithmetic, both readings reproducing the calibration group, and reading behaviour are tested.

transcription_verification.summary: Group values and quotes checked against the EMA report text in the repository; independent review pending.

reproduction.summary: Calibrated on the normal-renal-function group, so it reproduces that group by construction; this is not evidence of predictive performance.

external_consistency.summary: Calibrated on normal renal function only, then compared with the impaired groups of the same study. Secretion-preserved reading rejected (about 2-fold under-prediction in moderate and severe impairment). Intact-nephron reading (used here) consistent for mild and severe, under-predicts moderate (0.79 of observed AUC) and over-predicts its urine fraction (67% vs 42%): renal elimination appears to fall faster than in proportion to creatinine clearance.

further_reports.summary: End-stage kidney disease, non-dialysis day (Simulation 2.0c, plan locked before computation): with non-renal clearance held at the normal-group value, the model over-predicts exposure 1.31-fold with no residual kidney function and is consistent at 5 and 10 mL/min. Inconclusive, because the residual kidney function of the 6 subjects was not reported.

lenalidomide_exposure_safety_2016.name: Lenalidomide exposure-safety odds ratios (sponsor analysis CC-5013-MCL-001-PK; used for relative odds, Simulation 4.0a/4.0b)
lenalidomide_exposure_safety_2016.citation: Sponsor analysis CC-5013-MCL-001-PK as reported in the TGA AusPAR for lenalidomide (February 2016), clinical evaluation report section 4.2.4.1; same analysis also summarised in Chen et al., Clin Pharmacokinet 2017;56:139-152 (doi:10.1007/s40262-016-0432-1)

software_verification.summary: The relative-odds formula, the confidence limits (including their swap below the reference exposure), the between-patient range and its use with each PK model's clearance variability are tested (tests/test_lenalidomide_relative_odds.py).

transcription_verification.summary: TGA odds ratios and quotes checked against the plain-text copy of the AusPAR clinical evaluation report. Chen 2017 quotes were read through a web fetch and are not yet checked against the PDF. Independent review pending.

reproduction.summary: The source logistic regression cannot be reproduced: its intercept, baseline-count coefficients, exact AUC definition and number of myeloma patients were not published. This is also why only relative odds, not probabilities, are shown.

external_consistency.summary: No independent exposure-safety data have been compared. Chen 2017 reports the same sponsor analysis (pooled across diseases, thrombocytopenia odds ratio 3.337), so its agreement is not independent confirmation.

ixazomib_pk_gupta_2017.name: Ixazomib population PK (Gupta et al. 2017)
ixazomib_pk_gupta_2017.citation: Gupta N, et al. Clin Pharmacokinet. 2017;56(11):1355-1368
ixazomib_pk_gupta_2017.role: Typical total AUC on the ixazomib exposure page, inside the model scope only (ixazomib_scope_v1.json).

software_verification.summary: Closed-form three-compartment oral solution agrees with Runge-Kutta integration to 5e-12 relative; AUC to 20,000 h equals F x dose / CL; mass balance to 1e-14 (locked report, numerical_checks).

transcription_verification.summary: Table 3 read from the rendered page and cross-checked against the log-scale estimates; the BSA covariate form is inferred from the stated effects and the meaning of the % CV is unstated. Independent review pending.

reproduction.summary: No reproduction of the source's own results has been run on this platform.

external_consistency.summary: Dedicated renal (NCT01830816) and hepatic (NCT01912222) impairment studies, not used to build the model; plan locked before computation (amendment 1 before any group result). Total AUC0-last consistent in MM with normal renal function (575 vs model median 596 h.ng/mL, robust); under-predicted about 1.4-fold in solid-tumour patients with normal liver function and in both hepatic-impairment groups (robust); severe renal impairment under-predicted in the primary scenario only. Peaks under-predicted 2-4-fold in five of six groups. Impaired/normal ratios not distinguishable from no effect at these group sizes.

daratumumab_pk_luo_2021.name: Daratumumab population PK (Luo et al. 2021)
daratumumab_pk_luo_2021.citation: Luo MM, et al. J Clin Pharmacol. 2021;61(5):614-627
daratumumab_pk_luo_2021.role: Not used on any result page yet; its scope (daratumumab_scope_v1.json) fixes what a future implementation may show.

software_verification.summary: Runge-Kutta solution with linear and saturable elimination: mass balance to 5e-16, step halving changes results by 2e-8, and with Vmax = 0 the AUC equals dose / CL (locked report, numerical_checks).

transcription_verification.summary: Table S1 transcribed from the supplement; the sex factor on V1 is read from a garbled line and the time course of Vmax (KDES) is assumed exponential. Independent review pending.

reproduction.summary: No reproduction of the source's own results has been run on this platform.

external_consistency.summary: GEN501 and SIRIUS first-dose IV data (Clemens 2017), not used to estimate the parameters (the model's structure came from them); plan locked before computation. Peaks at 8 and 16 mg/kg and AUC to infinity at 8 mg/kg consistent; AUC over the first week at 16 mg/kg over-predicted (observed 0.87 of the model median), all robust across eight scenarios.

further_reports.summary: Second locked check with each study's own demographics (Clemens 2017 supplement): the GEN501 16 mg/kg first-week over-prediction widens (0.83, robust); SIRIUS 8 mg/kg AUC moves to the upper edge (1.18; under-predicted in the 75% IgG scenario). The albumin covariate predicts the opposite ordering of the two studies.

supersedes.change: Corrects two lenalidomide entries: the Hughes transcription layer (the supplementary control stream was reviewed for the variability blocks on 13 October 2026), and the Hughes and Kim outside-check summaries (the renal groups were defined by measured, not Cockcroft-Gault, creatinine clearance; see lenalidomide_renal_source_reconciliation_v1.json). No check result changes.
